subject: Linguistics
title: Flouting the Maxims
description: A short lesson to help you apply Flouting the Maxims.

hook.text: 'He's a fine friend!' said about someone who betrayed you. The sarcasm flouts the quality maxim.

buildup.text: Flouting means blatantly violating a maxim with the expectation that the listener will notice.

discovery.text: The listener knows the speaker is cooperative—so the violation must be deliberate and meaningful.

twist.text: Flouting quality produces irony; flouting quantity produces understatement or overstatement.

climax.text: Flouting is how speakers generate rich indirect meanings within Grice's framework.

punchline.text: Break the rules on purpose, and a new meaning appears.

quiz.question: What happens when a speaker flouts a maxim?
options: The listener infers an indirect meaning
